newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber flat, tone weak on Tokyo.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber flat, tone weak on Tokyo.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in slow late trading on Friday, with sentiment seen weak following falls in Tokyo, dealers said.
Dealers said February/March SIR20 offer prices remained at 54.50-55.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 54.25-54.50 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.75-54.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Tokyo rubber futures reversed early gains to end mostly weaker on Friday, as the yen's rebound against the dollar later in the day spurred profit taking, traders said.
Local rubber dealers track the Tokyo rubber futures for market direction as Japan is among Indonesia's most important rubber markets.
One Bangka dealer said there were bids at 53.50 cents fob Palembang, but no deals were done as sellers were seen holding firm to their offer prices.
Dealers said January high amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg in Bandung and Tangerang against 2,175 rupiah previously on the back of slow demand.
